annotation.title_clean: Principle-Code for Protection of intellectual property and transparency for the appropriate use of generative AI (provisional title) (draft)
annotation.title_en: Principle-Code for Protection of intellectual property and transparency for the appropriate use of generative AI (provisional title) (draft)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Cabinet Office, Intellectual Property Strategy Headquarters (Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Draft Japanese Cabinet Office principle-code for generative AI developers and providers, using a comply-or-explain approach. It requires disclosure on transparency (training data, crawlers, model details) and IP protection measures, plus disclosure on request to rights holders and users. It has no embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Comply-or-explain approach; businesses publish acceptance statements and annual updates
Principle 1: public disclosure of model history, architecture, training process, training data, crawlers and traceability
IP measures: respect robots.txt and paywalls, avoid pirated sites, use C2PA/watermarks, set up contact points
Principles 2 and 3: disclosure on request to prospective litigants and to users of generated outputs, on training-data sources
Exception for open-source users; government to evaluate disclosures and provide incentives
